evidence_rule: per strategy: < 30 completed trades INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE, 30-99 INITIAL EVIDENCE, 100+ STRONGER EVIDENCE; never a PASS
note: paper trades on live FYERS prices only; no synthetic or artificial trades
regime_basis: from daily bars of sessions before the trade day only: trend = 10-session efficiency ratio >= 0.40; high volatility = previous session's range in the top 20% of the 20 sessions before it
